triage.kind_span: This Issuer Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO relates to an offer by Saba Capital Income & Opportunities Fund (formerly known as Voya Prime Rate Trust), a Massachusetts business trust

subject_names.span: Saba Capital Income & Opportunities Fund (Name of Issuer)

subject_tickers.span: Saba Capital Income & Opportunities Fund (NYSE: BRW)

security_class.span: Common Shares of Beneficial Interest, no par value (Title of Class of Securities)

price_basis.span: in exchange for cash at a price equal to 99% of the net asset value

price_pct_nav.span: in exchange for cash at a price equal to 99% of the net asset value

nav_pricing_date.value: close of the regular trading session of the NYSE on the day the offer expires (the Pricing Date)
nav_pricing_date.span: determined as of the close of the regular trading session of the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”), the principal market on which the Shares are traded, on the day the offer expires (the “Pricing Date”)

size_pct_outstanding.span: The Fund is offering to purchase up to 30% of its Shares.

size_shares.span: The amount is based upon the offer to purchase up to 36,453,707 common shares in the offer (30% of the issued and outstanding common shares as of June 15, 2021)

commencement_date.span: June 21, 2021— Saba Capital Income & Opportunities Fund (NYSE: BRW) (the “Fund”), today announced the commencement of a tender offer for its outstanding common shares.

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at one minute past 11:59 p.m., Eastern time, on July 19, 2021, the Expiration Date, unless extended.

proration.span: If shareholders tender (and do not timely withdraw) more than the Offer Amount, the Fund will purchase duly tendered Shares from participating shareholders on a pro rata basis

spans: result in delisting of the Fund’s Shares from the NYSE
impair the Fund’s status as a regulated investment company
result in a failure to comply with the applicable asset coverage requirements applicable to senior securities of the Fund
there shall be instituted, pending or threatened before any governmental entity or court any action, proceeding, application or claim, or there shall be any judgment, order or injunction sought
any general suspension of trading in or limitation on prices for securities on the NYSE or any other exchange on which the Shares are traded
any other event or condition which, in the judgment of the Board, would have a material adverse effect on the Fund if the Offer were consummated

trigger_origin.span: On July 9, 2020, the Fund held its annual shareholder meeting at which shareholders approved a proposal requesting the Board to authorize a self-tender offer for at least 40% of the outstanding Shares of the Fund at or close to net asset value passed.

notes: Commencement document (Offer to Purchase dated June 21, 2021) for BRW (formerly Voya Prime Rate Trust). trigger_origin set to 'other': the filing ties the tender to a shareholder proposal approved at the July 9, 2020 annual meeting requesting a self-tender of at least 40% at or close to NAV; no enum value fits exactly (not stated as an activist settlement). size_shares 36,453,707 is stated in the fee-calculation footnote and the financing Q&A as 30% of 121,512,358 shares outstanding at June 15, 2021. Conditions 'other' covers the asset-coverage condition (a)(iv) and the orderly-loan-liquidation condition (b); deregistration condition (a)(ii) also exists. Board-fiduciary/legal-requirements condition (e) also maps to board_discretion. Saba-managed clients are expected to tender approximately 25.7 million Shares. No results reported in this filing.
